Nina (People Ops): Heads-up: If you're removing a dependent (divorce or aging out), what's the earliest removal date? Can we backdate removals?
Alex G: For aging out, coverage generally ends on dependent's 26th birthday per carrier. For divorce, you can remove them effective the divorce date but carriers need official docs (divorce decree).
Samir T: if ex-spouse moves to their own job coverage, do we need Proof of other coverage?
Nina (People Ops): We usually accept employer letter or insurance card showing effective date. removes take effect when benefits processes docs; payroll will prorate going forward.
benefits-bot: Reminder: COBRA offers may be triggered for former spouse; benefits team will send COBRA notice per federal requirements.
